items.difficulty_reason: RQ_Y ∘ Rf_* = Phi ∘ RQ_X for flat qcqs f: proves both composites are right adjoints to the same functor - f_* preserves QCoh (qcqs lemma), Phi computed on K-injective complexes of QCoh (Grothendieck K-injective embedding), f^* exact by flatness gives both adjunctions, and the four-term Hom chain Hom(A, RQ_Y Rf_* E) = Hom(A, Rf_* E) = Hom(f^* A, E) = Hom(f^* A, RQ_X E) = Hom(A, Phi RQ_X E) is computed in span.
